_note: VK-TERRAIN-NEAR-ORACLE-1: deterministic near-camera terrain oracle. Low-altitude ground-framing poses over the werewolf solid-terrain land region. Run with MC2_TERRAIN_LOD_CHUNK_FORCE_LOD=0 on BOTH GL and VK so every drawn block is lodStep==1 -> VK terrain island co-writes a large pixel region -> anti-tile/POM near-detail signal is exercised.
